_comment: Synthesized rules accumulated from weekly retrospectives. Updated at end of each scanner/retrospective/YYYYMMDD/ — append-only with conflict resolution. Read by /scanner Phase 0 step 8 and applied during Phase 2 selection.
_methodology:
Append-only. Each rule cites the retros that triggered it. Conflict resolution: most recent retro wins.

  Severity levels:
  - 'hard_block' = encoded in scanner-filters.json + validate-scan.js to refuse publication outright. Scan FAILS validation if violated.
  - 'selection_filter' = Claude applies the rule when CHOOSING the top 10 candidates at Phase 2. validate-scan.js surfaces violations as WARNINGS that should be fixed before publish.
  - 'advisory' = Claude biases selection (e.g. weight Pre-Squeeze higher in EARLY RISK-OFF) but a deviation is acceptable with rationale.
  - 'infrastructure' = always-on execution logic in sweep.js/signal-monitor.js, not a selection rule.
  - 'deprecated' = rule is no longer active, kept for historical context.

  v2.0 UPGRADE NOTES (20260619 audit):
  - Promoted regime-score-label-lag from advisory to hard_block (prevented D* grade week)
  - Promoted rr-min-by-regime from selection_filter to hard_block (100% violation rate with zero enforcement)
  - Promoted stopped-ticker-cooldown from selection_filter to hard_block (RIO double loss pattern)
  - Deprecated energy-early-risk-off-sizing (redundant with energy-early-risk-off-block)
  - Added 12 new rules from audit of 17 retros
  - All '?' values resolved, all rules have complete field sets

rules.description: Enforce minimum stop distance of 1.5x ATR(14) with absolute bounds of 3-8% from entry. Prevents intraday noise stops and degenerate tight/loose bands.
rules.rule: Stop minimum 1.5x ATR(14) du ticker. JAMAIS de stop < 3% absolu, JAMAIS > 8%. Applies to ALL strategies including Candlestick.
rules.rationale: Stops < 1.5x ATR triggered intraday before rebound (VRT -7.9%, COP -3.5%, COST -3.0%, IBM). Candlestick signals bypassed the check: QURE 44.66% stop, GRAF 0.55% stop published in 20260617-20260622 despite being far outside the 3-8% range.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#stops.min_atr_multiple=1.5, min_pct_from_entry=3, max_pct_from_entry=8 + validate-scan.js (must apply to ALL strategies including Candlestick)

rules.description: Enforce minimum risk/reward ratio per regime. RISK-ON 1:1.5, RECOVERY/NEUTRAL 1:1.7, EARLY RISK-OFF 1:2.0, RISK-OFF 1:2.0. Scan fails validation if any signal violates.
rules.rule: R/R minimum: RISK-ON 1:1.5, RECOVERY/NEUTRAL 1:1.7, EARLY RISK-OFF 1:2.0, RISK-OFF 1:2.0. validate-scan.js must emit VIOLATION (not advisory) when signals breach the floor.
rules.rationale: 20260618 scan: ALL 10 signals at R/R 1:1.7 in EARLY RISK-OFF requiring 1:2.0 -- 100% violation rate with zero enforcement. validate-scan.js lines 272-284 generated ADVISORY only. The single most egregiously ignored rule in the system.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js R/R check by regime label — MUST be violation-level, not advisory

rules.description: When regime score drops below 50 for 2+ consecutive scans while label remains RISK-ON, treat regime as NEUTRAL effective. Block publication if label diverges 2+ levels from score-implied regime.
rules.rule: When regime label rank exceeds score-implied rank by 2+ levels, validate-scan.js emits a HARD VIOLATION blocking publication. Score < 50 with RISK-ON label = at minimum NEUTRAL; score < 40 = EARLY RISK-OFF regardless of label. 2+ consecutive scans below 50 triggers strategy weight override: Momentum capped at 20%.
rules.rationale: Jun 1-3 2026: score 58->47->41 but label stayed RISK-ON. 8 Momentum entries stopped in <=2 days (AMZN -3.85%, LLY -3.15%, GOOGL -2.04%, PLTR -4.83%). Jun 17: RISK-ON label with score 40 (EARLY RISK-OFF territory) passed validation as advisory only. This single change would have prevented the D* grade week (20260612) and the 8-stop cascade.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js regime_score_coherence check — MUST be hard violation when label diverges 2+ levels from score-implied regime

rules.description: Block re-selection of stopped tickers for 5 trading days. Prevents compounding losses from consecutive-scan re-entries on the same name.
rules.rule: If a ticker was stopped in the last 3 scans, it is EXCLUDED from Phase 2 selection for 5 trading days. validate-scan.js checks signals.json[-3] + resolved trades for stopped status. Additionally, any ticker appearing in 3+ consecutive scans is blocked regardless of stop status.
rules.rationale: RIO stopped 16/06 (breakout -4.13%) then re-selected 17/06 (pullback -2.65%) = -6.78% cumulative on one name. GDX selected 2x at -2.82% and -5.16% MtM. SAN appeared in 4 consecutive scans. The rule was created AFTER the violation (20260619) and was only selection_filter -- audit demands hard_block.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check last 3 scans signals.json + resolved trades for stopped status. Hard block on re-selection within 5 trading days.

rules.description: Block manual regime overrides that diverge >0.2 from ensemble model near binary catalysts. Forced RISK-ON against ensemble NEUTRAL caused the D* week.
rules.rule: If forced_regime_label diverges > 0.2 from ensemble probability AND a binary catalyst (FOMC, NFP, CPI, geopolitical) is within 48h, BLOCK the override. validate-scan.js must reject scans with forced regime labels.
rules.rationale: Jun 4 scan forced RISK-ON 0.87 against ensemble NEUTRAL, producing 15 stops on 19 resolved signals. This single override caused the worst-ever D* grade (20260612). Impact score 10 -- the most damaging single event in scanner history.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — detect regime_override flag and compare to ensemble output. Hard block when divergence > 0.2 near catalysts.

rules.description: Short Squeeze strategy is permanently banned. 0% win rate across Feb-Mar 2026 retros.
rules.rule: Short Squeeze EXCLU de toutes les strategies. Strategies autorisees UNIQUEMENT: Momentum, Pre-Squeeze, Breakout, Pullback, Candlestick.
rules.rationale: 0% WR documented across 2 consecutive months. Dead strategy.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#strategies.forbidden + validate-scan.js rule 3

rules.description: Reject setups where entry price diverges >10% from current spot. Catches stale cache, pre-split prices, and data errors.
rules.rule: abs(entry - spot_price) / spot_price > 0.10 -> REJECT. Entry must be validated against real-time market price at Phase 2.
rules.rationale: 25% of early setups had entry prices diverging >10% from market (ADBE at $430 vs real $260, ADP at $303 vs $216). Stale cache or pre-split prices feeding the scanner. Impact score 9.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — compare entry to last close from MCP QueryData. Hard block on >10% divergence.

rules.description: Reject setups with entry-stop band < 0.5x ATR14 or where closing price at scan time already exceeds TP1 (stale entry).
rules.rule: abs(entry - stop) / ATR14 < 0.5 -> REJECT. close_at_scan > tp1 -> REJECT as stale entry. FCX 0.5% band, KRSP/RDAG 2-4 cents stops produce rule-resolved trades with no predictive value.
rules.rationale: Degenerate stop distances produce trades resolved by noise, not signal. FCX had a 0.5% band, PAYO 0.57%, GRAF 0.55% too tight; QURE 44.66%, NMRA 46.79% too loose. The 3-8% range check was bypassed by Candlestick signals.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — ATR-relative band check + stale entry check against current close. Hard block.

rules.description: TP1 must be calibrated to horizon. H10 -> TP1 at 1.5R max, H15+ -> TP1 at 2R max. Prevents unreachable targets that convert into expired-positive (money left on table).
rules.rule: if horizon <= 10 then tp1_distance <= 1.5 * risk_distance; if horizon > 10 then tp1_distance <= 2.0 * risk_distance. Encode in scanner-filters.json and validate-scan.js.
rules.rationale: Most persistently identified gap across 6 retros. 87%+ setups expire positive without hitting TP1 in one retro. Every retro since March flagged TP1 targets as too ambitious, yet no rule existed. Converting expired-positive into TP1 hits would significantly improve the grade (Pillar 1 = Setup HR).
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check tp1_distance / risk_distance against horizon-based cap. Advisory initially, promote to selection_filter after 2 retros of confirmed improvement.

rules.description: Minimum composite score of 80 for top 10 selection. Setups under 75 have systematically underperformed.
rules.rule: score < 80 -> REJECT from top_10. If fewer than 10 candidates above 80, reduce scan size rather than dilute quality.
rules.rationale: Setups under score 75 have systematically underperformed across multiple retros. Quality floor prevents bottom-of-barrel picks from diluting the top 10.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check composite score >= 80 for all top 10 signals. Selection filter.

rules.description: Treat correlated asset pools (crypto, metals) as single positions for sizing. Cap exposure when regime score < 50.
rules.rule: if regime_score < 50: max 1 crypto-momentum signal, max 2 metals signals per scan. WLD/NEAR/INJ and FCX/SCCO/COPX must be treated as correlated pools.
rules.rationale: WLD/NEAR/INJ (crypto) and FCX/SCCO/COPX (metals) were stopped in bloc during the same shock in the D* week. Correlated pools amplify drawdown when they move together. Impact score 8.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check correlation pool membership and enforce caps per regime score. Selection filter.

rules.description: Apply score penalty (-10 to -15) to sectors misaligned with dominant regime theme. Counter-theme sectors fail systematically.
rules.rule: if regime favors energy/commodity and candidate is tech/growth breakout -> score -= 10. if regime favors tech/growth and candidate is defensive/commodity -> score -= 10. FSLR solar in oil rally, tech momentum in Risk-Off all failed.
rules.rationale: Counter-theme sectors fail systematically across 4 retros. FSLR solar in oil rally failed, tech momentum in Risk-Off failed. Sector-regime alignment is a necessary condition for setup success.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — apply score penalty based on regime analysis. Pending encode in validate-scan.js.

rules.description: Require minimum 10% pullback before re-entering a ticker that was in the top 3 of the previous retro. Prevents chasing extended winners.
rules.rule: if ticker in top_3_previous_retro AND pullback_from_recent_high < 10% -> REJECT.
rules.rationale: AG re-entered at $31 after +32% run, got stopped at -11.3%. Extended winners need a meaningful pullback before re-entry offers a valid risk/reward.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check previous retro top 3 and pullback from recent high. Selection filter.

rules.description: When VIX > 28, force minimum 5/10 picks to be defensive/commodity/short-hedge. Suspend tech and EU ETF momentum until VIX < 22.
rules.rule: if VIX > 28: min 5 of 10 signals must be defensive/commodity/hedge sector. Tech and EU ETF momentum suspended until VIX < 22.
rules.rationale: VIX > 28 = Full Defensive Tilt. During Mar 3-13 Risk-Off (VIX >25), Defensive/Hedge had 100% hit rate while EU/Asia ETFs had 0%. Impact score 8.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check VIX level and enforce minimum defensive allocation. Selection filter.

rules.description: When open positions >= 12, reduce new setups to 5. Portfolio crowding degrades scan quality.
rules.rule: if count(scanner-positions.json.open_positions) >= 12 then max_new_setups = 5.
rules.rationale: Apr 16 scan quality degraded from portfolio crowding. The A* grade week (20260417) was achieved with focused 50-signal scans, not 80-90 signal bloat.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check open position count before setting scan size. Selection filter.

rules.description: Block Breakout strategy in EARLY RISK-OFF. Institutional buyers step back and liquidity thins in risk-off transitions.
rules.rule: if early_risk_off_prob > 0.40 AND strategy == Breakout -> REJECT. Breakout in EARLY RISK-OFF produced stops in 3+ consecutive retros.
rules.rationale: Breakout hit rate in EARLY RISK-OFF: 0% (20260515), 0% (20260403). Institutional buyers step back during risk-off transitions, leaving breakout entries without follow-through liquidity. Impact score 7.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check regime probability and block Breakout when early_risk_off > 0.40. Selection filter.

rules.description: Cap same-strategy signals per scan: max 1 Pullback in EARLY RISK-OFF, max 2 of any single strategy in any regime.
rules.rule: if regime in [EARLY RISK-OFF, RISK-OFF]: max 1 Pullback per scan; any regime: max 2 of same strategy per scan.
rules.rationale: LLY+DE double stop on same day caused by 2 pullback entries in EARLY RISK-OFF. Correlated strategy exposure amplifies single-factor losses.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — count strategies per scan and enforce caps. Advisory.

rules.description: Check regime persistence before placing pullback entries. Transient EARLY RISK-OFF (1-2 days) creates opportunities; structural (3+ days) destroys them.
rules.rule: if same regime label for >= 3 consecutive sessions -> apply regime-specific strategy caps (Pullback near-zero in sustained EARLY RISK-OFF). Check signals.json[-3] for consecutive regime labels.
rules.rationale: Transient EARLY RISK-OFF creates pullback opportunities but structural EARLY RISK-OFF (3+ days) produces mean-reversion failures. Regime persistence matters more than regime label.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check consecutive regime labels before placing Pullback entries. Selection filter.

rules.description: Penalize tickers appearing in 3+ consecutive scans. Exhausted momentum produces diminishing returns.
rules.rule: if ticker appeared in 3+ of last 5 scans -> score -= 5 * (appearances - 2). SAN in 4 consecutive scans is the reference violation.
rules.rationale: SAN in 4 consecutive scans, RIO/GDX in 2 consecutive scans. When a ticker fails after repeated picks, double-exposure compounds losses. Frequency across 4 retros.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check scan history and apply score penalty. Advisory.

rules.description: Gate materials/industrials breakouts on macro alignment. CLF, FCX collapsed on tariff/China demand headwinds.
rules.rule: if sector in [Materials, Industrials] AND strategy == Breakout AND macro_headwind_detected (tariff escalation, China PMI contraction, VIX > 25) -> score -= 10.
rules.rationale: CLF, FCX collapsed on tariff/China demand headwinds. Materials/industrials breakouts without macro tailwind are fragile. Frequency across 3 retros.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check macro context before selecting cyclical breakouts. Advisory.

rules.description: When regime changes 2+ times in 5 scanner days, reduce position size 30% and widen stops 1.5x ATR on all new setups.
rules.rule: If regime changed >= 2x in last 5 scanner days: reduce sizing 30% + widen stops x1.5 ATR. Detected via data/scanner.json[-5].regime comparison.
rules.rationale: Week 20260518-22 had 4 rotations RECOVERY->RISK-ON->EARLY R-OFF->RISK-ON in 5 days. Breakouts/Momentum entered in quickly-invalidated conditions bled out. Audit found this rule is dead letter -- 20260617 scan showed no sizing reduction despite 4 regime changes across 4 consecutive scans.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — detect regime change frequency and enforce sizing reduction. Must be upgraded from advisory.

rules.description: Limit high-beta AI infra setups to max 1 per scan in RECOVERY or EARLY RISK-OFF. Block if RSI > 72 or distance from 50-DMA exceeds 2x strategy cap.
rules.rule: Maximum 1 high-beta AI infra setup per scan in RECOVERY/EARLY RISK-OFF. Hard block if distance_50dma_pct exceeds 2x strategy cap (ARM at 59.6% vs 20% cap = 3x limit should hard-block). RSI > 72 daily = hard block.
rules.rationale: VRT 20260518 (RECOVERY, +38% above 50-DMA, RSI 75) crashed -7.9%. ARM at 59.6% above 50-DMA (cap 20% for Momentum) published without block. INTC at 34.1% (cap 25%), HIMS at 34.8% -- all published without block. The overextension checks generate advisory only, never violations.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#overextension + validate-scan.js — hard violation tier when distance exceeds 2x strategy cap

rules.description: Trailing stop does not activate before 50% of the path to TP1 when initial R/R >= 1:2.4. Prevents premature exit on strong breakouts.
rules.rule: Trailing stop ne s'active pas avant 50% du parcours vers TP1 quand R/R initial >= 1:2.4.
rules.rationale: Trailing too early on high-R/R breakouts cuts the distribution tail. Already encoded in modes-config v5.2+ for balanced/secured. Working as designed but not verifiable from signals.json alone.
rules.enforced_by: modes-config.json (sweep-optimized trail params per mode)

rules.description: In sustained RISK-ON (2+ days), target 45% Momentum / 30% Breakout. In EARLY RISK-OFF, invert: 40% Breakout, 30% Pullback, 20% Momentum.
rules.rule: RISK-ON continu >= 2j: Momentum 45%, Breakout 30%. EARLY RISK-OFF: Breakout 40%, Pullback 30%, Momentum 20%. Claude MUST respect these weights -- audit found 80% Momentum in EARLY RISK-OFF (20260618) vs 20% target.
rules.rationale: Retro 20260425: Momentum > Breakout under sustained RISK-ON (HR 65% vs 45%). But 20260617-18: 60-80% Momentum allocation in weak regimes (score 40) completely ignored the regime-based weights. Claude overrides these weights without consequence.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — surface strategy weight deviation as advisory. Claude Phase 2 alignment.

rules.description: Allocate 25% of top 10 to Pre-Squeeze when regime is EARLY RISK-OFF and volatility compression detected.
rules.rule: Si regime = EARLY RISK-OFF et compression volatilite detectee (bbw < hhv20(bbw)*0.6), allouer 25% du top 10 a Pre-Squeeze.
rules.rationale: Retro 20260502: Pre-Squeeze HR 70% in EARLY RISK-OFF -- best strategy for that regime. But 20260618 is EARLY RISK-OFF with 0/10 Pre-Squeeze signals. Rule has never been enforced in recent scans.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — surface Pre-Squeeze underallocation as advisory when regime is EARLY RISK-OFF

rules.description: Hard disqualification for any ticker with earnings within 3 trading days. No exceptions.
rules.rule: Aucun ticker avec earnings dans +/-3 jours de bourse. DISQUALIFICATION dure.
rules.rationale: TimesFM accuracy drops to 40% (vs 56% baseline) near earnings. Multiple retros confirmed disastrous hit rate on setups near the print. Working as intended -- all recent signals have earnings_clear=true.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#earnings_window + GetEarningsCalendarFiltered cross-check + validate-scan.js

rules.description: Immediate disqualification if recent SEC filing (<90 days) mentions aggressive underwriters. Prevents micro/small-cap dilution traps.
rules.rule: DISQUALIFICATION immediate si SEC filing (S-1, S-3, 424B) < 90j mentionne aggressive underwriter (H.C. Wainwright, Maxim, Roth Capital, Ladenburg, Dawson James, Aegis, EF Hutton, Boustead).
rules.rationale: INDO 20260406 diluted 80% of float within 30 days -- toxic fund + ITM warrants. Working as intended -- all recent signals have dilution_clear=true.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#dilution_blocklist + QueryData types=sec_filings,flags

rules.description: Entry effective = min(open_next_session, VWAP_next_session) clamped to day_low. Gap-up > 2% triggers VWAP pullback fill only.
rules.rule: Entry effective = min(open_next_session, VWAP_next_session) clamped a day_low. Si open > entry_high * 1.02, fill uniquement a VWAP pullback.
rules.rationale: Sweep optimization validated +29% PnL, +16pp WR, 2.5x PF (commit 91596bd9). Protected the book from 14 gap-up traps in 20260619 retro (31% no-fill rate). Always-on infrastructure.
rules.enforced_by: sweep.js + signal-monitor.js + portfolio API (always-on, not grid-searched)

rules.description: Minimum diversification: 5 US + 2 EU + 1 APAC + 2 ETFs, max 3 per sector, max 3 repeats vs previous scan.
rules.rule: Top 10: 5 US + 2 EU + 1 APAC + 2 ETFs. Max 3 setups par secteur. Max 3 repeats vs scan precedent.
rules.rationale: Sector concentration = principal correlated drawdown vector. max_per_sector is hard_block; country floors are selection_filter.
rules.enforced_by: scanner-filters.json#diversification + validate-scan.js rule 6 (max_per_sector=hard_block, country_floors=advisory)

rules.description: Disqualify all Energy sector setups when early_risk_off probability > 0.30. Energy crashes systematically in EARLY RISK-OFF windows.
rules.rule: DISQUALIFIER tout setup Energy quand GetRegimeProbability early_risk_off > 0.30.
rules.rationale: 3 consecutive retros: COP -3.51%, TTE -2.47%, plus similar patterns. Energy sector = -5.98% avoidable losses. 20260618 EARLY RISK-OFF had no energy signals, suggesting Claude applied the rule, but validate-scan.js has no safety net.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — regime-aware sector block needed. Currently Claude Phase 2 only.

rules.description: In high-confidence RISK-ON (>70), wait for -0.3% intraday pullback before entering gap-up setups. Urgency reduced after 0% BE rate follow-up.
rules.rule: En RISK-ON > 70 confidence, si open > entry_high * 1.01, attendre pullback -0.3% depuis l'open.
rules.rationale: RISK-ON 85 (May 26-28) produced mostly breakevens. UPDATE 20260606: BE rate 0% on following period, confirming 40% was specific to May regime oscillation. Rule active as guard but urgency reduced. No infrastructure implementation.
rules.enforced_by: advisory — Claude mentions gap-up risk in setup thesis. No sweep.js implementation.

rules.description: When regime oscillated 2+ times in 5 days, raise mcap floor to $50B and cap commodity/small-cap to max 1 per scan.
rules.rule: Quand regime change >= 2x dans 5 derniers jours: mcap minimum $50B, commodity/small-cap max 1 par scan.
rules.rationale: TSM (+6.35%), MS (+5.33%), ARM (+4.22%) = top 3, all mega-caps. COP, TTE (commodities), BTBT (small-cap) = worst 3. HIMS ($7.5B) selected in 20260618 during regime oscillation. RBLX ($28B) selected in 20260617. Multiple sub-$50B names pass through. Audit recommends upgrade to selection_filter.
rules.enforced_by: Claude Phase 2 — check regime change count and adjust mcap floor. Must be upgraded from advisory.

rules.description: Pullback strategy only allowed when regime confidence > 60%. In oscillating regime, replace Pullback with Momentum or Breakout.
rules.rule: Pullback UNIQUEMENT si regime confidence > 60%. En regime oscillant (confidence < 60%), Pullback -> remplacer par Momentum ou Breakout.
rules.rationale: Pullback 0% WR on 20260519-29. RIO Pullback in 20260617 with regime score 40 (well below 60% confidence) -- the rule should have blocked this but was ignored. Audit recommends upgrade from advisory.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check regime confidence and block Pullback below 60%. Selection filter.

rules.description: Reject signals with score >= 93 AND RSI14 < 55. High score + weak price action = value trap.
rules.rule: score >= 93 AND rsi14 < 55 -> REJECT.
rules.rationale: Backtest v8: 0 winners, 2 losers on resolved trades matching this pattern. Zero false positives. Narrow but functional.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check score/RSI combination. Selection filter.

rules.description: For Momentum strategy, reject if RSI14 between 40-50. Directional limbo with no momentum edge.
rules.rule: strategy == Momentum AND rsi14 in [40,50] -> REJECT (except turbo mode).
rules.rationale: Backtest v8: 7 losers saved, 1 winner lost (7:1 ratio). EXCEPTION: skip for turbo (LMT false positive).
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check RSI for Momentum signals. Selection filter.

rules.description: TKL pool minimum quality: price >= $5, score >= 88. Prevents penny stock day-1 blowups.
rules.rule: source == tkl_pool AND (price < 5 OR score < 88) -> REJECT.
rules.rationale: Backtest v8: 8 day-1 stop-losses at avg -7% = -5.63% portfolio impact prevented.
rules.enforced_by: validate-scan.js — check price and score for TKL pool signals. Selection filter.

rules.description: If closing price exceeds entry by >2% at Phase 2 time, adjust entry to estimated VWAP J+1 or exclude. Reduces no-fill waste.
rules.rule: Si close > entry * 1.02 au moment Phase 2, proposer entree ajustee (VWAP estime J+1) ou exclure. Cible: no-fill rate < 15%.
rules.rationale: 14/45 signals (31%) no-fill due to Iran ceasefire rally. Gap-ups > 2% are predictable when SPX gained > 2% the prior day. Pre-filtering reduces slot waste. No infrastructure implementation yet.
rules.enforced_by: advisory — Claude checks close vs entry spread at Phase 2.

rules.description: Reduce sizing by 0.7x on tickers with ATR relative > 4% when regime oscillated in last 3 days.
rules.rule: Quand regime change >= 1x dans 3 derniers jours: sizing x0.7 sur tickers ATR/prix > 4%.
rules.rationale: SAIA (ATR 22.66 = 4.8% relative) produced -7.01% -- largest loss of week 20260615-18. High absolute ATR amplifies per-position drawdown in oscillating regime. No enforcement metadata visible in signals.
rules.enforced_by: advisory — Claude applies via OptimizeSizing constraint override.

rules.description: DEPRECATED: Reduce energy sizing to x0.5 in EARLY RISK-OFF. Redundant with energy-early-risk-off-block which prevents energy entirely.
rules.rule: Si EARLY RISK-OFF ET tickers Energy encore presents, sizing x0.5.
rules.rationale: Redundant. If energy-early-risk-off-block works, energy never appears and this rule never triggers. If the block fails, this advisory also fails. Audit recommends removal.
rules.enforced_by: deprecated — superseded by energy-early-risk-off-block
